# betterado_git_repositories (Data Source)

Reads Git repositories in an Azure DevOps project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

data "betterado_git_repositories" "example" {
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
}

output "repository_names" {
  value = [for r in data.betterado_git_repositories.example.repositories : r.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_hidden` (Boolean) Include hidden repositories in the result. Defaults to false.
- `name` (String) Filter repositories by name (case-insensitive).
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to list repositories for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A hash-based ID derived from the repository names.
- `repositories` (Attributes List) A list of repositories matching the filter criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `default_branch` (String) The ref of the default branch.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the repository is disabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of the repository.
- `name` (String) The name of the repository.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID the repository belongs to.
- `remote_url` (String) Git HTTPS clone URL.
- `size` (Number) Size of the repository in bytes.
- `ssh_url` (String) Git SSH clone URL.
- `url` (String) REST API URL for the repository.
- `web_url` (String) Web URL for the repository.
